description: This file defines React functional components that serve as placeholders for various chart types (Line, Bar, Pie). It includes utility functions for generating deterministic bar heights and clamping numbers, and exports placeholder components for future chart integration.

methods.name: clampNumber
methods.description: Clamps a number n between min and max, returning min if n is not a valid number.

methods.name: buildSeededBars
methods.description: Generates an array of deterministic bar heights for UI stability.

methods.name: ChartFrame
methods.description: A React component that provides a styled frame for chart placeholders, displaying title, subtitle, and children.

methods.name: LineChartPlaceholder
methods.description: Placeholder component for a line chart, generating sample points for future data integration.

methods.name: BarChartPlaceholder
methods.description: Placeholder component for a bar chart, generating deterministic bar heights.

methods.name: PieChartPlaceholder
methods.description: Placeholder component for a pie chart.
